d: One of the craziest street parties I have ever experienced was in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. In this video, I take you along to an incredible street party with my hostel friend Anna, where we explore the celebrations, watch live bands, enjoy the music, and experience the amazing energy of Brazilian street culture. There were so many people, performances, and unforgettable moments. Honestly, it was one of the wildest parties I have ever seen.
